When writing the review comment:
- Start with Overall: followed by a one-sentence risk assessment (High/Medium/Low) and a short summary.
- List findings as markdown bullet points. Each item should cite the file and line numbers when possible.
- Suggest actionable fixes or verification steps for every issue you raise.
- End with Follow-up: and include any remaining questions or TODOs for the author.
Keep the tone direct and professional.
